week_label: Week of Sep 21 – Sep 25, 2026 · First Day of Fall
note: Showroom feed — every image features real products SDLR installs, and each caption names the selections so followers can DM to get the look. Seasonal moment: the autumnal equinox falls Tue Sep 22, so Tuesday is a tasteful first-day-of-fall post (a Mt. Helix fire lounge at dusk — no kitschy autumn graphics, no promo). Driveway/curb appeal returns Monday (Point Loma), on the every-couple-weeks cadence after Encinitas on Sep 7. Shot mix rotates the five pillars across distinct neighborhoods: Point Loma curb-appeal driveway (design/neighborhood), Mt. Helix fire lounge for the first evening of fall (seasonal/lifestyle), a honed-travertine material detail (craft/process), a Del Sur outdoor kitchen & bar (amenity/lifestyle), and the 10-Month Walk-Through in Carmel Valley (trust). All five images FRESHLY GENERATED 2026-09-14 with Nano Banana Pro (no library reuse) — varied job tiers, one photograph each, unified warm-neutral grade, no people. Post natively in the Instagram app.

posts.alt: Point Loma coastal home with a wide paver driveway, stone-veneer entry columns, olive trees and drought-tolerant planting at soft afternoon light
posts.hook: The first thing anyone sees is the part most people forget.
posts.caption:
Everyone pours the backyard budget out back. The approach — the driveway, the entry, the first thirty feet a guest ever sees — gets left in bare concrete.

We treat it like the opening line of the house. A full paver driveway, stone-veneer columns to frame the entry, olives and low drought-tolerant planting to soften the edges. It sets the tone before the door even opens.

The selections:
• Belgard paver driveway
• Eldorado Stone entry columns
• mature olive trees
• drought-tolerant borders
• FX Luminaire path lighting

Want your approach to match your home? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Mt. Helix hillside backyard at dusk with a sunken fire-pit lounge, low stone seat walls, agave and a mountain-valley view
posts.hook: First evening of fall. The one the fire was built for.
posts.caption:
Fall in San Diego isn't a color change — it's a temperature. The first cool evening arrives, and the sunken lounge with the fire lit becomes the only place anyone wants to sit.

Dropped a step below grade and wrapped in stone seat walls, it holds the warmth and holds a conversation. Built for exactly this stretch of the year, when the nights turn and the backyard gets its second season.

The selections:
• Warming Trends CrossFire burner
• sunken lounge with stone seat walls
• Techo-Bloc Aberdeen pavers
• agave & drought-tolerant planting
• low-voltage landscape lighting

Want a spot built for the cool evenings? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.style: Craft & Process · The Material Up Close
posts.alt: Close-up of honed silver travertine paving with water droplets on the surface beside an agave, showing the stone's natural veining
posts.hook: Stand on it barefoot in August and you'll understand the whole spec.
posts.caption:
Travertine gets specified for how it looks in a photo. We specify it for how it feels underfoot.

Honed silver travertine stays cool in full sun, sheds water instead of glazing over, and the natural veining means no two pavers repeat — so a large deck never reads like a stamped pattern. The stone is the finish and the function at the same time.

The selections:
• honed silver travertine (Arizona Tile)
• filled-and-honed surface
• French-pattern layout
• polymeric sand joints
• agave & succulent accents

Want to feel the difference the right stone makes? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Del Sur backyard at sunset with a covered pergola, full outdoor kitchen and bar, fire pit and travertine patio
posts.hook: The party stops being in the kitchen when the kitchen moves outside.
posts.caption:
The tell of a backyard people actually gather in: nobody drifts back indoors. A real outdoor kitchen does that — enough counter to plate for a crowd, a bar to lean on, and a fire close enough to keep the night going.

Out in Del Sur the lots give you the room to lay it out properly: cooking, seating, and fire as three connected zones under one pergola, so the host never leaves the conversation.

The selections:
• Lynx built-in grill
• stainless bar with seating
• StruXure louvered pergola
• Warming Trends fire pit
• travertine patio

Want a kitchen that keeps everyone outside? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Carmel Valley backyard at dusk with a stone outdoor fireplace, deep seating, string lights and a travertine patio
posts.hook: We put a date on the calendar for ten months after we leave.
posts.caption:
Anyone can hand over a beautiful space on day one. The question is what it looks like after it's lived through a full year of use.

So we schedule the 10-Month Walk-Through before we finish — and we come back. We walk the whole yard with you, fine-toothed, catch the small things that only time reveals, and make them right. Part of every project, never a line item.

The selections:
• Eldorado Stone fireplace
• deep linen seating
• Techo-Bloc patio
• café string lighting
• FX Luminaire uplighting

Want a builder who comes back? DM “DESIGN”.
